report:
Independently reassessed the complete alternative_isolation claim and all two implementation/three test associations. Verified exact current bytes against historical implementation_sources and test_sources for merge.rs, semantic_spec.rs and harness lib.rs; claim and implementation metadata also match. Test metadata differences are only the former embedded source field, now represented by test fragments. This supports the historical scope/rationale, not a new execution claim.

Completed-answer reduction in merge.rs sorts/deduplicates canonical stashed answers, recognizes unconditional Proven answers only with empty substitution and trivial obligations, and conservatively compares remaining definite answers using output-aware subsumption. Type outputs must directionally match; proof/type mismatches cannot subsume. Multiple live/incomplete possibilities flow to hint reduction, rather than arbitrarily selecting a normalization value. Local copies/renamed response parameters separate answers during comparison. The ordinary final_answer_rules_are_order_independent test visibly asserts identical unconditional results for three candidate orderings plus duplicate Maybe and all-No behavior. The ordinary incompatible_normalization_outputs_are_ambiguous_but_identical_outputs_merge test creates two actual impl definitions and solves a canonical normalization query without expected-output filtering; it asserts Yes for bool/bool and Maybe for bool/i32, plus nonzero balanced unordered candidate spans. Captured fixture helpers install source, build its root, and locate the actual trait/associated type. These assertions substantiate the implemented reduction examples, not universal isolation.

Every remaining aspect is explicitly retained as deferred: per-candidate isolated publication including failed/cancelled equality, universe, wake and obligation leakage; full canonical-response permutation coverage; retaining shared hard information across live concurrent siblings; and cancellation only after reconciling that information. The semantic_spec implementation TODO specifically identifies concurrent conjunction and cancellation isolation as beyond current completed-answer reduction, and its associated TODO test enumerates those verification scenarios. Its empty body supplies no behavioral evidence. Prerequisites are implementing concurrent conjunction/cancellation transactions and reconciliation, then adding observable leakage and shared-information tests and the broader permutation matrix. No explicit priority exception is exercised or claimed implemented by these tests; current evidence covers equal outputs and conservative subsumption. The linked transaction/producer principles are accounted for by these isolation and reconciliation obligations, not asserted independently proven. Existing partial evidence plus explicit TODO accounting remains justified; no reclassification or edits requested.

Validation: source inspection, exact historical comparison, and review start/read/record only. No behavioral test suite or workspace build was executed by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 sage-meta tests and cargo build passing; those are not evidence of the deferred runtime guarantees.
